_comment: New Vibe Test Phase 7 (F.25) golden regression set. TEMPLATE FILE -- the cases below are illustrative placeholders, not validated real cases, because this sandbox has no knowledge of AEP_Dashboard's actual staging URLs/credentials/allowed domains. Before this is useful, replace target_url/environment_url/goal/reference_image_path with real values for a handful of representative, STABLE flows (login, a core CRUD action, a settings page) and capture real reference screenshots via the existing UI Test flow. See run_golden_set.py's module docstring for how and when to run this.

functional_cases.goal: TEMPLATE: Log in with valid credentials and verify the dashboard home page loads
functional_cases.expected_results: TEMPLATE: User lands on the dashboard home page with their name visible in the top nav
functional_cases.notes: Happy-path smoke case. Should stay green run over run -- a regression here means the core login/nav flow, the agent's action-planning loop, or the GEval judge itself has drifted.

functional_cases.goal: TEMPLATE: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password and verify an error message is shown
functional_cases.expected_results: TEMPLATE: An inline error message is shown and the user remains on the login page
functional_cases.notes: Negative-path case. Regressions here often mean the agent is mis-scoring an expected failure state as a real failure, or the judge prompt/threshold has drifted -- see ai_eval.py.

functional_cases.goal: TEMPLATE: Navigate to a deliberately nonexistent page (e.g. /this-route-does-not-exist) and confirm a normal page loads
functional_cases.expected_results: TEMPLATE: A normal application page (not a 404) is shown
functional_cases.notes: Canary case: this SHOULD fail every time. If it ever comes back passed/needs_review, the harness or the judge is broken, not the app -- treat any change here as a P0 signal about ai_runner.py/ai_eval.py itself, not about AEP_Dashboard.

ui_cases.notes: Capture reference_image_path once from a known-good render (e.g. via the existing UI Test flow's reference upload) and commit it alongside this fixture. Regenerate deliberately when the page's design legitimately changes -- never to silence a real regression.
